title: Workflow: Full system setup order
body: Master order for new UAE/Qatar deployments. Details: docs/implementation/module-setup-dependencies.md. Financial deep steps: docs/implementation/financial-setup.md.
steps: Open Setup Hub (/setup) and Help topic setup-order.
1 Companies: create UAE (AED) and/or Qatar (QAR) legal entities on /companies.
2 Currency: confirm AED/QAR on /currency (create in SAO if missing).
3 Administration: users, groups, sequences, modules on /users /groups /sequences /modules.
4 Party → 5 Product → 6 Stock → 7 Calendar using list screens and SAO for deep fields.
8 Financial: CoA, fiscal year, journals in SAO; draft invoice on /financial (see financial-setup.md).
9 Health: institution (/settings), patients, appointments; lab/pharmacy/beds as in scope.
Do not invent tax rates or HIE rules — mark needs confirmation.
